question: Google Trends, United States: the share of weekly search interest taken by each of Tesla, iPhone, Samsung, Netflix and Disney for the week Sun Nov 1 - Sat Nov 7, 2026. All five are measured in one comparison request, so their weekly indices sit on a single shared scale; forecast each brand's percentage of the five-brand total. The five shares add to 100.
resolve: the first archived five-query comparison snapshot (US, web search, trailing 12-month window) carrying the completed week ending 2026-11-07; each brand's value divided by the sum over the five, in percent
unit: percent of the five-brand basket (the five add to 100)

question: The ordered top-10 articles on the English Wikipedia by pageviews for the week Mon Nov 2 - Sun Nov 8, 2026. The seven daily top-1000 lists published by Wikimedia are summed per article and ranked; Main_Page and every non-article namespace (Special:, Wikipedia:, Portal:, Help:, File:, Template:, Category:, Draft:, User:, Talk: and their _talk: variants) are excluded. Give the ten article titles in order, rank 1 first.
resolve: Wikimedia daily top endpoint (top/en.wikipedia/all-access), the week's seven archived daily lists summed per article, exclusion rule main_page_and_namespaces_v1 applied, top 10 by weekly total, ties broken by title ascending. An article absent from a day's top-1000 contributes zero for that day.
unit: ordered list of 10 en.wikipedia article titles, canonical underscore form, rank 1 first
